title: Naqsha IR v1
description: Author-facing JSON for Naqsha: one small IR in, one self-contained interactive HTML out (src/CONTRACT.md §1). This schema is the machine-readable form of the contract for documentation and optional future ajv use; src/validate/index.mjs is the zero-dependency source of truth. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (and the validator enforces): node ids are unique; edge from/to must reference existing node ids and must not be equal; duplicate (from, to, label) edges are rejected; group ids are unique, group.nodes is a non-empty subset of node ids and no node may appear in two groups; node.group must reference a declared group; group.kind 'fragment' is only allowed for type 'sequence'; nodes/edges/groups/notes counts and label lengths are bounded.

title.description: Human diagram title (trimmed length 1..80 characters), e.g. "Checkout service map".

subtitle.description: Optional context line under the title, max 120 characters, e.g. "production, 2026-10".

type.description: Diagram family: sequence = participants + ordered messages; workflow = ordered steps; architecture = services and boundaries; erd = tables + columns; class = types + relations; tree = single-parent hierarchy; timeline = dated events; waterfall = spans with start + duration; dataflow = pipeline stages; lifecycle = states + transitions.

direction.description: Layout direction, top-to-bottom or left-to-right. Ignored for type 'sequence'.

nodes.description: 1..40 nodes. For sequence diagrams these are participants in declared order.

edges.description: 0..80 directed edges. For sequence diagrams these are messages in declared order.

groups.description: Optional visual groups (zones/boundaries) or sequence fragments. Group ids unique; member nodes must exist and belong to at most one group.

notes.description: At most 4 footer notes, each max 140 characters.

allOf.description: group.kind 'fragment' is only valid for type 'sequence'.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case id: start with a letter, then a-z, 0-9 or '-', max 32 characters. Unique within its collection.

label.description: Short human label shown in the card; over 40 characters warns about wrapping.

sublabel.description: Optional detail line under the label; soft limit 80 characters (warning only).

kind.description: Node kind; drives shape and colour. service=app/API, datastore=db/cache, actor=human, external=third party, queue=broker, compute=worker, security=auth/gateway, state=step/status, note=annotation.

group.description: Optional id of a declared group. Must match a group.id in groups[]. Missing/mismatched membership is warned, unknown groups are an error.

stage.description: Dataflow stage name; declaration order defines columns.

at.description: Timeline position: ISO date string or finite number.

start.description: Waterfall span start, same unit as duration.

node.description: One node. `kind` is required for architecture/workflow/sequence and optional for the v1.2 types (they default per type).

from.description: Source node id. Must exist in nodes and differ from 'to'.

to.description: Target node id. Must exist in nodes and differ from 'from'.

label.description: Optional edge label, e.g. "GET /cart"; soft limit 32 characters (warning only).

kind.description: Edge kind; drives stroke and arrow style. main=request, return=response, async=fire-and-forget, security=auth, message=sequence message, data=db/cache I/O.

edge.description: One relationship. `kind` is required for architecture/workflow/sequence and optional for the v1.2 types.

kind.description: zone/boundary = box around nodes; fragment = loop/alt band, only for type 'sequence'.

nodes.description: Non-empty subset of node ids; a node may appear in at most one group.
